roles.title: AI Product Manager — AI Labs founding team

bullets: Get obsessed with the customer. Talk to SMB owners, watch them work, mine the signal sitting in our millions of existing users — find the problem they actually have, not the one…
Validate it, then sharpen it. You start with a promising idea, not an answer. Prove the need is real, then turn it into a specific customer, a specific problem and a wedge worth…
Run on hypotheses, not opinions. Form a sharp hypothesis, design the test, read the result honestly even when it stings, move.
Own whether it works. Activation, time-to-value, engagement, retention — know these numbers cold and push them yourself. Did people get the outcome, and did they come back? That's…
Turn mess into a thing worth building. Insight is cheap; a sharp, buildable product decision is not.
